dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL dialect used in Japanese medical administration system

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-hoshuu) system - staff/employee information management screen (W06), handling user registration, occupation codes, medical department codes, authority flags, and related master data
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It manages staff/employee information settings (ORCGW06), including occupation classification, user IDs, authority flags, medical department codes, and various master data for the clinic management system. It handles screen navigation, data entry, and updates to system management masters.

notable_features: 73 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
253 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses GnuCOBOL/ORCA framework instead of CICS)
Japanese EUC-encoded comments (latin-1 decoded with mojibake)
OCCURS clauses for table handling (up to 200 entries)
Screen SPA (Scratchpad Area) pattern typical of ORCA framework
Revision history spanning 2000-2010 with multiple contributors
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but contains Japanese EUC-JP encoded text, resulting in mojibake in comments. This is characteristic of the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. The program is a screen handler (W06) for staff information management within the ORCA framework, which uses its own screen/transaction management rather than CICS. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of 183475 bytes total.
